finding: Slovak firms' bank loan availability outlook diverged from improving EA trend
bullets: A net 6.46% of Slovak firms (n=104) expected bank loan availability to deteriorate in wave 39—worsening by 1.30 pp from wave 38, while the EA improved by 1.45 pp to a net 2.35%, signalling tighter conditions ahead.
Credit line availability expectations eased by 3.16 pp to a net 3.87% of Slovak firms (n=136) expecting deterioration—compared with a net 2.25% for the EA, still pointing to cautious lender behavior.

Trade credit pessimism receded, with a net 6.18% of Slovak firms (n=90) expecting deterioration—improving by 4.04 pp from wave 38's net 10.22%, though remaining above the EA's net 1.87%, limiting supplier-backed financing options.
chart_subtitle: A net 6.46% of Slovak firms expect bank loan availability to deteriorate.
